description: NOTE: no Renovate bot runs against git.ericsweiss.com by default, so this config is INERT until you run self-hosted Renovate (or the Renovate GitLab app) against your project. Until then, bump image tags manually. See README 'Keeping image tags current'.

packageRules.description: Group patch/minor bumps into one PR to cut noise.

hostRules.description: Private GitLab registry hosting this app's own image. A self-hosted Renovate bot must supply credentials for this host via its OWN config/env (a Docker/registry token) — do NOT commit a token here. Without it, Renovate cannot query the private tag list.

kubernetes.description: Track container images pinned in the Flux manifests.
